task_description: Phase 5 Step 2 of Continuum: integrate the first REAL libretro core, PCSX ReARMed (PS1), through the SOFTWARE frame path, as a thin passthrough loader (Option 1, dlopen + forward retro_*). Close the native_core.rs loader gaps (environment commands, pixel-format negotiation, need_fullpath), add an iOS cross-compile path to scripts/build-core.sh (platform=ios-arm64, interpreter-first), embed the core dylib through project.yml/build-engine.sh/package-ipa.sh and assert it in the ios.yml .ipa verify, and wire the Swift host + SESSION_HANDOFF.md. NO MoltenVK/Vulkan this step. Keep the 74 cargo tests and the 15/15 switch-wrapper harness green. macOS build + on-device boot are verified only by the orchestrator's CI run afterward.

verification.summary: All Linux-verifiable gates pass. cargo test: 74 passing (plain) and 84 passing (--features native-core,uniffi-bindings, +10 new PS1 loader tests). cargo check --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings: clean. cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings: clean. cargo clippy --features native-core,uniffi-bindings --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean. cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown: clean (web/wasm build untouched). ./native/switch-wrapper/build.sh host: 15/15. bash -n on build-core.sh/build-engine.sh/package-ipa.sh: valid. project.yml + ios.yml: valid YAML. swiftc -frontend -parse ContinuumApp.swift: parses (spell-check only, no iOS SDK here). Test quality reviewed: the 10 new native_core.rs tests call the real on_environment with correctly shaped C payloads and assert against the real NEGOTIATED_FORMAT global and ContentHint::from_filename; they would fail if the SET_PIXEL_FORMAT / GET_VARIABLE / refusal / full_path logic were reverted. The dylib filename pcsx_rearmed_libretro_ios.dylib is consistent across build-core.sh, build-engine.sh, project.yml, package-ipa.sh, and ios.yml (traced). docker_build is skipped: this project has no Dockerfile; the equivalent macOS/Xcode .ipa build and on-device PS1 boot cannot run in this Linux sandbox and are verified only by the orchestrator's CI run afterward.
